payload.friendly_name: Analyze readiness gate: finalize validation, WP prompts, requirement quality
payload.purpose_context: Issues #246, #237 and #247 (epic #244): the analyze step prompt can declare a mission ready while machine-checkable task metadata is broken, WP prompt files are missing or underspecified, or requirements are untestable. This mission edits the software-dev analyze and specify prompts and cave-kitty's analyze copy so the readiness verdict reflects them.
payload.purpose_tldr: Make /spec-kitty.analyze catch broken task metadata, weak WP prompts and low-quality requirements before implementation starts.

payload.question: Confirm the extracted requirement set (FR-001..FR-017, NFR-001..NFR-004, C-001..C-006) for #246/#237/#247 plus cave-kitty?
When finalize-tasks --validate-only cannot run, should analyze record a MEDIUM finding plus residual-risk warning, or a HIGH finding that blocks the verdict?

payload.final_answer: HIGH (fail closed): verdict blocked; the finding names the CLI version that provides the check
Confirm as listed, with the FR-004 version gate (CLI >= 3.1.0a5; missing/no JSON/older -> HIGH)

options: New tactic(s) cited from the prompts
payload.question: Where do the #237/#247 checks live: inline in the analyze/specify prompts, or in new foundation tactic(s) scoped to the specify and analyze actions and cited from the prompts?

payload.final_answer: New tactic(s) cited from the prompts: requirement-quality-ears (specify, analyze) and wp-prompt-readiness-review (analyze)
